notes:
ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP fetch only (requests + bs4/lxml, Chrome UA). robots.txt (https://2xlhome.com/robots.txt) has User-agent:* Allow:/ with only checkout/customer/search-param style Disallows plus a small OpenAI-bot block; no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web disallow found, so no block on any tier. Site is Magento-based (ae-en locale, /accessory/, /furniture/, /kids/ paths). No 403/anti-bot wall encountered; tier (a) sufficed for the whole pass, tiers (b)/(c) not needed. TREE: built from union of homepage mega-menu (nav.navigation, 268 unique links) and the product sitemap (https://2xlhome.com/media/2xlhome/sitemap2xl.xml, grepped for storage/textile keywords) - sitemap surfaced no category nodes beyond the mega-menu, only product URLs and one CMS landing page (/ae-en/curtains, body class cms-curtains/cms-page-view, no product count - excluded as a non-catalog CMS page per View-All/Collection/Promotional rule, same treatment as /ae-en/landing-cz/mattress-style pages). Every leaf's h1 and canonical link were confirmed to match the requested URL before recording. QTY: each leaf's own listing page has a Magento power-listing toolbar with a
N Item(s)
element (server-rendered, not AJAX-only) - qty taken verbatim from that div on that exact URL; explicit 0-item categories recorded as qty=0 (legit-zero, category exists and page confirms zero). Parent/group pages (Soft Furnishing, Bedlinen, Cushions, Duvets & Pillows, Table linen, etc.) show their own aggregate counts but were NOT recorded as rows since valid subcategories exist (parent-URL rule); one exception is Mattress Protectors (bed-protection URL) which itself lists 4 distinct products in addition to its child Mattress Toppers subcategory, so both were recorded as sibling leaves rather than treating Mattress Protectors as a pure group. EXCLUDED (checked, not included): Furniture/Living/Storage, Furniture/Bedroom/Bedroom Storage (Night Stands, Dressers), Furniture/Dining/Dining Serve & Storage (Sideboard, Dining Mirrors, Serving Trolley), Kids Storage under Kids Furniture (Kids Nightstand, Kids Dresser) - all verified via product samples to be dressers/nightstands/sideboards/shelving = Furniture domain, already covered by Furniture.xlsx. Tray Tables (accessory/kitchen/kitchen-storage/tray-table-dishrack-utensil-holder) - despite the URL slug, sampled products are serving trays and tray tables (Kitchen & Dining/Furniture), not storage organizers. Baskets and Tissue Boxes under Home Decor > Decor Accessories > Boxes & Trays - sampled products are 'Klo Decorative Basket' and decorative tissue/book boxes, explicitly decorative per product naming and site placement, not storage. Organizers under the same Boxes & Trays node - sampled products are decorative 'Book Box Set of 2' items (decor objects styled as books), primary function is decorative display not storage, so excluded despite the category label. Kids Tote & Kids Basket (0 items) - excluded by analogy with the adult Baskets node (Home Decor domain) and because tote bags are excluded from Storage per rules; Bean Bags (0 items) - excluded as ambiguous furniture-adjacent seating, not textile/storage. Kids Bath Accessories - sampled products are tissue box/soap dish/waste bin/tray, not textile or storage. Wallpapers/Wall Panel, Curtains CMS page, all Kitchen & Dining serveware/tabletop nodes, Wall Decor, Lighting, Garden, Home Fragrance/Decor Accessories nodes - out of scope for both Textile and Storage per the rule files' boundary sections, not recorded. LOW-CONFIDENCE / REVIEW: Jewelry Holders (Storage, qty 5) flagged MEDIUM - jewelry boxes provide genuine storage/organization function but sit under Home Decor > Decor Accessories rather than a Storage section, and could arguably be Decorative Home Accessories instead. Fillings (Textile, qty 22) flagged MEDIUM - the category mixes finished 'Cotton Filled Cushion' products with standalone 'Cushion Filler' inserts.
